confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors use current Brisbane cost-of-living averages; cocktail uses a recent local average. Wine is estimated at about 1.25 times the local beer price. Accommodation anchors are broad estimates from general knowledge and vary with season; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator; use Brisbane local food and drink prices and a broad Australian capital-city basis for accommodation.
